directions.route_direction_description:
Trains depart Frankston and operate via Kananook, Seaford, Carrum, Bonbeach, Chelsea, Edithvale, Aspendale, Mordialloc, Parkdale, Mentone, Cheltenham, Southland, Highett, Moorabbin, Patterson, Bentleigh, McKinnon, Ormond, Glen Huntly, Caulfield, Malvern, Armadale, Toorak, Hawksburn, South Yarra, Richmond to Flinders Street.
Most trains stop all stations; express services operate during weekday peaks.

City stations: Parliament, Melbourne Central, Flagstaff, Southern Cross and Flinders Street.
City Loop: Services to Flinders Street run from Parliament. Services from Flinders Street operate direct to Richmond.

Stopping patterns: During weekday peak periods, some selected express services run as follows:
Morning peak (to city): Express from Cheltenham to Caulfield, then Malvern, South Yarra, Richmond and via the City Loop to Flinders Street.
Afternoon peak (to Frankston): Depart Flinders Street, express to Caulfield, then express to Cheltenham, continuing all stations to Frankston.

Exact Stopping patterns may vary between peak periods and specific services, so passengers should check the timetable for individual train stopping arrangements.

Exceptions and Special running conditions
Night Network services run approximately hourly overnight on Friday and Saturday nights. Services run direct to and from Flinders Street and do not run via the City Loop.
Trains may run to altered schedules or be replaced by buses during weekends, public holidays or late at night.
